verses.english: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?

verses.bangla: যেদিন মানুষ হবে বিক্ষিপ্ত পতংগের মত
verses.english: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,

verses.bangla: এবং পর্বতমালা হবে ধুনিত রঙ্গীন পশমের মত।
verses.english: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
He will be in a pleasant life.
But as for one whose scales are light,
His refuge will be an abyss.
And what can make you know what that is?
It is a Fire, intensely hot.
